approval.approved_by: project coordinator via user-directed G0 closure
approval.scope: Candidate-only J02 evaluation after G1-G8. This approval does not score A09 and does not alter its frozen inputs.

derivation.original_defect_population: excluded from baseline bounds; reported separately
derivation.method: Exact observed current-control baseline extrema/rates. These are baseline non-regression bounds, not final readability, cleanup, glyph, ownership, or style acceptance.

hard_invariants.rationale: Candidate source and export PNG dimensions must match before measurement.
Roster ID, source SHA-256, revisions, snapshot and artifact hashes must match the selected candidate manifest.
Every source-reviewed owner/action must have a fresh source-pixel-reviewed association. Explicitly unresolved associations fail candidate evaluation.
A reviewed replacement owner may not disappear silently.
Preserve/review/explain source pixels may not acquire rendered replacement text.
Multiple reviewed owners may not be silently merged onto one candidate region.

bounded_metrics.derivation: 24-control maximum; intentionally non-quality-dispositive pending G7 glyph/layout work
24-control observed total; candidate report must also retain page-level count

not-yet-measurable.method: Browser/native-resolution glyph bounds plus visual review; stored element size is not a substitute.
Reviewed glyph-mask/source-difference measurement with fixed support and boundary tolerance.
